visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short black hair wearing a black t-shirt sits at a table in an indoor space. He holds silver-tipped black chopsticks and looks down at a white cardboard bento box filled with roasted meat slices, green broccoli, and rice. The background is a grey textured wall with the words 'THE DODO MEN' visible at the top. (2) The scene cuts between medium shots and close-ups of the food. The man picks up a piece of meat with his chopsticks, looks at the camera, and places it in his mouth. He chews with an exaggerated expression of joy and satisfaction, closing his eyes. Another person's arm and dark blue shirt are partially visible on the right side of the frame. (3) The man continues to talk enthusiastically, holding a small clear plastic packet of red chili sauce. He demonstrates pouring the sauce over the meat in the box. He gestures with his hands and chopsticks while looking toward an off-screen companion. A glass jar and some dried decorative branches are on the shelf behind him.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a lifestyle vlog segment where the creator showcases a cost-effective Taiwanese bento box. The core appeal lies in the dramatic price and value comparison between the meal in Taiwan (approx. $5 USD) and its equivalent in the United States (approx. $12 USD), delivered with high energy and humorous expressions to engage viewers interested in food and travel cost comparisons.
